classification.difficultyReason: Extend the supplied inequality-class pattern, assign boundary values such as 20.0 and 30.0 correctly, then use the frequencies to identify the modal class and calculate a percentage of all plants.

inlines.text: Here are the heights of some plants. The heights are in centimetres to 1 decimal place. Complete the grouped frequency table.
Continue with class width 10 cm. Include each upper endpoint in its class: 20.0 belongs to

children.label: a
children.prompt: Which class interval has the highest frequency?

answer.worked: The highest frequency is 7, so the modal class is $20<h\leq30$ cm.

children.label: b
children.prompt: What percentage of the plants are less than or equal to 10 cm tall?

answer.worked:
There are 3 plants at most 10 cm tall out of 20 plants.
$$\text{Percentage}=\frac{3}{20}\times100\%=15\%.$$
